seo.meta_description: Taco Palenque is a Laredo-born Mexican chain famous for the Pirata taco. What a Pirata is, who founded Taco Palenque and where its 40-plus locations are.
seo.h1: Taco Palenque and the Pirata Taco, Explained

question: What Is Taco Palenque Known For?
quick_answer: Taco Palenque is a Mexican fast-casual chain founded in Laredo, Texas, on July 1, 1987, by Juan Francisco 'Pancho' Ochoa, the same restaurateur who started El Pollo Loco. It's best known for the Pirata taco, a big flour tortilla filled with grilled fajita meat and refried beans, plus mesquite-grilled fajitas and a salsa bar with more than seven homemade salsas. It has about 42 locations: 39 in Texas and three in Monterrey, Mexico.
key_facts: Founder Pancho Ochoa also started El Pollo Loco
About 42 locations (39 in Texas, 3 in Mexico)

body.heading: What is a Pirata taco?
body.text: The Pirata is Taco Palenque's signature taco and the item most fans order first. It's a large, handmade flour tortilla filled with grilled fajita meat and creamy refried beans, making it closer to a hearty folded meal than a small street taco. On our Taco Palenque menu page it's listed at about $4.89.

body.heading: Other menu favorites
body.text: Besides the Pirata, Taco Palenque is known for flame-grilled beef and chicken fajita plates, parrilladas (mixed grill platters), Panchos (tortilla chips loaded with beans, cheese and toppings), breakfast tacos and homemade desserts. Every location has a salsa bar with more than seven homemade salsas.

body.heading: Who founded Taco Palenque
body.text: Juan Francisco 'Pancho' Ochoa, originally from Sinaloa, Mexico, created the El Pollo Loco grilled-chicken concept before opening Taco Palenque in Laredo on July 1, 1987. His idea was a drive-thru Mexican fast-food chain serving authentic food. In 2005 the Ochoa family also opened Palenque Grill, a sit-down, full-service sister restaurant with margaritas and parrilladas.

body.heading: Where Taco Palenque is
body.text: Taco Palenque started in Laredo and spread across South Texas, reaching McAllen in 1998, Brownsville in 2001, San Antonio in 2007 and Houston in 2010, and later central Texas cities like Round Rock. Today it has about 42 locations, 39 in Texas and three in Monterrey, Nuevo León. Use the store finder on Taco Palenque's website for hours, since many locations serve breakfast.

body.heading: Prices
body.text: Taco Palenque is affordable: breakfast tacos start around $1.99, fajita tacos run about $2.79 to $4.19, and fajita plates about $11 to $13. See our Taco Palenque menu page for full prices.

faqs.q: Is Taco Palenque related to El Pollo Loco?
